metadata.description: Galtea skills for AI coding assistants, and an opt-in Claude Code plugin that sends your Claude Code sessions to Galtea as traces. The skills authenticate, manage products, versions, specifications, datasets, metrics, endpoint-connections, run and monitor evaluations, and inspect sessions, traces, and spans through natural conversation.

plugins.name: galtea
plugins.description: Interact with the Galtea Platform. Authenticate, manage products, versions, specifications, datasets, metrics, endpoint-connections, run and monitor evaluations, and inspect sessions, traces, and spans.

plugins.name: galtea-tracing
plugins.description: Send each Claude Code conversation to Galtea as a production session: each turn is a trace, with its model calls, tool calls and subagents as spans.
